scope: P2-44 diagnostic subset: one-ball capture through nip and open ramp to the basket entrance; no basket retention, multi-ball or launch claim

geometry.ramp_attachment: fixed to base/chassis; the launcher moves independently

basket_entry_base_frame.basis: Existing basket front floor Z=54 mm plus a 33 mm ball radius; 96 mm clear opening leaves +/-15 mm centre travel for a 66 mm ball.

criteria.name: condition_success_count
criteria.rationale: Retains the accepted repeatability gate while reducing the matrix to the requested diagnostic subset.

criteria.name: basket_entry_reached
criteria.rationale: Success now requires the complete ball centre to reach the physical basket mouth, not merely the previous guide datum.

criteria.name: fully_through_nip
criteria.rationale: Separates capture failure from ramp/entry failure.

criteria.name: plough
criteria.rationale: Same frozen P2-43 definition; prevents a pushed ball from being counted as capture.

criteria.name: jam
criteria.rationale: The longer 124 mm curved ramp path justifies 0.75 s, but persistent wedges remain failures.

criteria.name: d5065_torque
criteria.rationale: 20 A times the frozen Kt=0.031 N m/A.

criteria.name: forbidden_launcher_contact_count
criteria.rationale: P2-40 launcher/pivot/arch geometry remains frozen; any new launcher-to-ramp/chassis/ground contact stops the campaign.

diagnostics: ball path and final failure owner
